items.text: Dhavhidhi akaimbira Jehovha mashoko orwiyo urwu paakarwirwa naJehovha kubva muruoko rwavavengi vake vose nomuruoko rwaSauro.
"Jehovha ndiye dombo rangu, nhare yangu uye mununuri wangu;
Mwari wangu ndiye dombo rangu, ndinovanda maari,
Ndiye nhare yangu, utiziro hwangu nomuponesi wangu,
Ndinodana kuna Jehovha, iye anofanira kurumbidzwa,
Akanzwa inzwi rangu ari mutemberi yake;
makore erima akanga ari pasi petsoka dzake.
Akandinunura kubva pamuvengi wangu ane simba,
asi Jehovha akanga ari mutsigiri wangu.
maererano nokuchena kwamaoko angu, akandipa mubayiro.
handina kuita chakaipa ndichitsauka kubva kuna Mwari wangu.
Mirayiro yake yose iri pamberi pangu;
Jehovha akandipa mubayiro maererano nokururama kwangu,
kune vasina chavanopomerwa munoratidza kusapomerwa kwenyu,
asi meso enyu ari pamusoro pavanozvikudza kuti muvaderedze.
Jehovha anoshandura rima rangu kuti rive chiedza.
Norubatsiro rwenyu ndinogona kuenda kundorwa neboka ravarwi;
"Kana ari Mwari, nzira yake yakarurama kwazvo;
Uye ndianiko Dombo kunze kwaMwari wedu?
Anoita tsoka dzangu kuti dzive setsoka dzenondo;
kuitira kuti zvitsitsinho zvangu zvirege kutsauka.
uye havana kugona kumuka; vakawira pasi petsoka dzangu.
makaita kuti vadzivisi vangu vakotame patsoka dzangu.
Makaita kuti vavengi vangu vatize pakurwa,
Vakachemera kubatsirwa, asi hakuna munhu akavaponesa,
kunyange kuna Jehovha, asi haana kupindura.
ndakavatswa uye ndikavatsika sedope riri munzira dzomumusha.
Vanhu vandakanga ndisingazivi vava pasi pangu.
Ngaakudzwe Mwari, iye Dombo, Muponesi wangu!
Naizvozvo ndichakurumbidzai, imi Jehovha, pakati pendudzi;
